scope: Plan a final Chinese-owned 4,480-glyph atlas. Original Japanese glyph identity is not preserved; one-byte printable ASCII slots stay reserved and every other renderer-addressable slot may be assigned sequentially or left blank.

requirements: Keep the current P10 compatibility font until the target translated surfaces no longer need Japanese fallback glyphs.
Re-render the 95 one-byte printable ASCII glyphs at their fixed indices with the selected production font.
Before promoting the full atlas, run a representative code from every standard resolver row and every raw trail class used by the sequential plan.
Add any proven direct-index non-text glyph to the reserved-slot set before materializing the full font.
